metadata.scenario: An individual calls to inquire about the price for office space rentals. Category: New Inquiry. Outcome: quote_provided. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, my name is Karen Lewis. I was referred by my husband’s cardiac surgeon’s office. Nice to meet you, Karen! How can I help you regarding your husband’s care? Well, he’s scheduled for cardiac surgery next month, and I’m looking into post-operative care options. Absolutely, we can definitely assist with that. What specific services are you interested in? I need to know about skilled nursing care and any other support he might need during recovery. For post-surgery recovery care, we offer skilled nursing visits that include medication management and health monitoring. That sounds great. What are the costs associated with skilled nursing care? The price for skilled nursing care ranges from $95 to $125 per visit, depending on the specific services required. Okay, and how long do those visits typically last? Each visit usually lasts between one to two hours. That’s helpful. Will he need any additional therapies post-surgery? He may benefit from physical therapy as well, which is $110 to $140 for a 45 to 60-minute session. I see. I’ll need to discuss this with him after surgery. Of course, take your time. Would you like me to prepare a care plan for him? Yes, that would be helpful. What would be the next steps? I can schedule a consultation with our care coordinator, Lisa Chen. She can assist with the care plan development. That sounds good. When is Lisa available? Lisa is available from Monday to Saturday. Would you prefer a specific day? How about next Tuesday? Let me check... Yes, she’s available next Tuesday. What time works for you? How about 10 AM? Perfect! I’ll set up the appointment for you. Great, thank you. Will I receive a confirmation? Yes, I’ll send you a confirmation email with all the details right after this call. Thank you, Margaret. I really appreciate your help. You're welcome, Karen! Don’t hesitate to reach out if you have any more questions. I will. Thanks again! Have a great day! You too! Goodbye. Goodbye!
